tianxia.talent.equipment.quick_harness.why: Donning and doffing armor is done between fights: the table has no don-or-doff action and no time cost to shorten. The printed halving and quartering still applies at the table.

tianxia.talent.equipment.sleep_in_armor.why: Native observed-time rest preparation requires owned Sleep in Armor and armor proficiency; heavy fitted suits are unready after an actual completed long rest until ten minutes of refitting.

tianxia.talent.equipment.underplate_chan.why: Which one small item is secured in the Fitted Armor is chosen when the character is built. The secured item is not a weapon, so it never takes one of the two hands a weapon attack needs.

tianxia.talent.equipment.instant_harness.why: Taking the worn armor on or off needs the armor to be an object the fight can see. The worn armor is fixed when the fighter is compiled, so there is nothing for this Action to change yet.

tianxia.talent.equipment.armor_answers_t.why: Calling the armor to you needs the armor to be an object on the map that can travel to you. The worn armor is fixed when the fighter is compiled, so this Action cannot yet fetch it.

tianxia.talent.equipment.armor_training.why: Light, then medium, then heavy armor proficiency is a choice made when the character is built; its result is already in the Armor Class the sheet publishes.

tianxia.talent.equipment.field_maintenan.why: Source-authored qualified armor-maintenance checks execute actual native rolls. Field Maintenance grants contextual Advantage only for its seven printed tasks and proficiency with that physical suit. No crafting, item creation or object-HP restoration is granted.

tianxia.talent.equipment.hidden_plates.why: Owned Hidden Plates disguises source-qualified worn light or medium armor. Native visual/touch searches roll the searcher's Intelligence (Investigation) against Equipment Save DC; touch grants the searcher Advantage.
